an5.144:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sākete viharati tikaṇḍakīvane.
an5.144:2.1: sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ appaṭikkūle paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyya.
an5.144:2.2: sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ paṭikkūle appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyya.
an5.144:2.3: sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ appaṭikkūle ca paṭikkūle ca paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyya.
an5.144:2.4: sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyya.
an5.144:2.5: sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ appaṭikkūlaṃ ca paṭikkūlaṃ ca tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako vihareyya sato sampajāno.
an5.144:3.1: kiñca bhikkhave bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca appaṭikkūle paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyya?
an5.144:3.3: idaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca appaṭikkūle paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyya.
an5.144:4.1: kiñca bhikkhave bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca paṭikkūle appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyya?
an5.144:4.3: idaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca paṭikkūle appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyya.
an5.144:5.1: kiñca bhikkhave bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca appaṭikkūle ca paṭikkūle ca paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyya?
an5.144:5.2: “mā me rajanīyesu dhammesu rāgo udapādī”ti, “mā me dosanīyesu dhammesu doso udapādī”ti.
an5.144:5.3: idaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca appaṭikkūle ca paṭikkūle ca paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyya.
an5.144:6.1: kiñca bhikkhave bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyya?
an5.144:6.2: “mā me dosanīyesu dhammesu doso udapādī, mā me rajanīyesu dhammesu rāgo udapādī”ti.
an5.144:6.3: idaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūlasaññī vihareyya.
an5.144:7.1: kiñca bhikkhave bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca appaṭikkūlaṃ ca paṭikkūlaṃ ca tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako vihareyya
an5.144:7.2: sato sampajāno? “mā me kvacini katthaci kiñcana rajanīyesu dhammesu rāgo udapādi, mā me kvicini katthaci kiñcana dosanīyesu dhammesu doso udapādi, mā me kvacini katthaci kiñcana mohanīyesu dhammesu moho udapādī”ti.
an5.144:7.3: idaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca appaṭikkūlaṃ ca paṭikkūlaṃ ca tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako vihareyya sato sampajānoti.
